title: Wild Horse Nine

note: A24 documentary. Fielder embeds with Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her partner Billy Evans during the 34 days before Holmes reported to federal prison; what began as a month of filming became a three-year project. Secret-screening premiere at Telluride (Sep 6, 2026); Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes; opened to ~$15.6M on 855 screens (biggest non-concert documentary opening since Fahrenheit 9/11), ~$45M domestic through Oct 25. THEATRICAL ONLY for now. Playing this week in Sacramento (Cinemark Century DOCO, Regal Delta Shores) and listed at El Dorado Hills, the closest screens to Fiddletown — checked Oct 26.
title: You Can See Everything

cast: Dennis Christopher, Dennis Quaid, Daniel Stern, Jackie Earle Haley
note: The cycling classic: in Bloomington, Indiana, 19-year-old Dave Stoller — obsessed with the Italian Cinzano racing team, Italian opera, Italian everything — and his three 'cutter' friends take on the Indiana University establishment in the Little 500 bike race. Steve Tesich's script won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay. A natural for Dave: former competitive cyclist, and the hero's name is a bonus. Not on any subscription service right now — rent or buy only (checked Oct 29).
